subject: Urgent: Streaming chat p99 spikes during peak - action required (Brightline Health)
messages:
From: Sam Wells <sam.wells@brightline.health>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: platform-ops@brightline.health
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production impact - streaming chat p99 spikes

Markus,

We're seeing a sustained p99 latency regression on the hosted streaming chat endpoint during our evening peak window (18:00 - 19:30 PDT). Customer-facing sessions start to time out at ~1.9s p95 and p99 climbs past 4.5s for step responses; overall error rate to your websocket/SSE endpoint jumps from ~0.2% to ~2.8%. This started after the 02:00 deployment (your time) where a kernel-level optimization was introduced.

I've attached a short snippet of logs and our Grafana screenshot (dashboard-p99-heatmap.png). You can see the spike correlates with an increase in partial-completions and RETRY errors tied to runtime-alloc.

This is affecting several enterprise customers behind our account (we emailed users) — we need an ETA on mitigation and whether you can temporarily route us to a stable model variant or revert the change.

Sam
Head of Platform Reliability
Brightline Health

Attachments: error-sample-logs.txt (text), dashboard-p99-heatmap.png (image)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sam Wells <sam.wells@brightline.health>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - streaming chat p99 spikes

Sam — thank you for the heads-up and the attachments. We see the same signal inside our platform metrics. I'm escalating to SRE and runtime immediately. Short answers: (1) we'll open a dedicated incident channel and invite your ops; (2) we can route Brightline to the last stable model variant immediately as a mitigation; (3) we will investigate whether the 02:00 kernel change correlates.

Action items I am initiating now:
- @dev_patel: run quick rollback test for the kernel optimization and post results (target: 30m).
- @hannah_schmitt: lead capacity/traffic policy changes (enable burst scaling + temp throughput bump).
- @monica_patel: coordinate CS comms and a short M-A-P (mutual action plan) doc for Brightline.

Sam, can you confirm if you want the immediate route-to-stable (zero-downtime switch) now? We'll also share a short timeline.

— Markus
VP, Customer Success (on-call)

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, Sam Wells <sam.wells@brightline.health>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - streaming chat p99 spikes

Quick update from runtime: initial traces show KV-cache miss rate jumped ~22% concurrent with the p99 spike; tokenization latencies are stable. The new fused-attention kernel increases mem pressure in longer-history sessions and appears to cause periodic GC stalls in the allocator when the session KV grows beyond our fast-path threshold — that explains the partial completions and retry loops.

Immediate mitigations I'm testing now (running on canary):
- toggle fused-attention=off for Brightline traffic (should bypass the new kernel) -> expect p99 to drop within 2-5 minutes if that's the root cause.
- increase per-instance serialization buffer to reduce KV churn (20% bump).
- temporary routing to the previous model build (non-fused kernel) as fallback (zero-downtime).

I'll post results in 20m. If the fused kernel is the cause we'll coordinate a rollback.

— Dev (runtime)

Forwarded-attachment: mut_action_plan_template.xlsx (will populate)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, Sam Wells <sam.wells@brightline.health>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - streaming chat p99 spikes

Team — I just pushed an autoscaling policy adjustment to increase burst nodes for the region handling Brightline; this should give us ~30% more headroom for the 18:00 window. I'm also enabling the routing switch to the previous model build now (will confirm within 3 minutes).

If routing to stable reduces p99 we will keep it for the remainder of peak and then run a regression test on the fused kernel in a dedicated perf lab.

Sam: if we see >50% reduction in p99 within 5 minutes we will leave the fallback in place and follow up with a postmortem.

— Hannah
SRE Manager

On Tue, Jul 30, 2028 at 08:45 AM PDT, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick update from runtime: initial traces show KV-cache miss rate jumped ~22%...

From: Sam Wells <sam.wells@brightline.health>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: platform-ops@brightline.health, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 09:14:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - streaming chat p99 spikes

Thanks — we approved the immediate route-to-stable. Please proceed; our ops are standing by to monitor. Can you also confirm whether any customer-visible session state will be reset by the switch? We have long-running conversations so session continuity is important.

Sam

On Tue, Jul 30, 2028 at 08:28 AM PDT, markus_klein@redwood.ai wrote:
> Sam — thank you for the heads-up and the attachments...

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sam Wells <sam.wells@brightline.health>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Bcc: exec_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - streaming chat p99 spikes — mitigation and next steps

Sam — update and plan: we completed the route-to-stable at 09:16 PDT (switched Brightline to last stable model/engine). Within 4 minutes your p99 dropped from ~4.8s to ~1.6s and error rate returned to baseline. The autoscaling burst added extra capacity and prevented queued request pressure.

Next steps:
- Incident postmortem (shared doc link) scheduled EOD; runtime will validate the fused-attention kernel in perf lab before any re-release.
- We're preparing a short M-A-P and a credit offer for the impacted window; Monica will send the formal note and the MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx).
- We'll provide a timeline for a non-disruptive re-test of the kernel with instrumentation toggles for Brightline.

Sam, appreciate your quick confirmation to route to stable. We'll keep your ops on the incident channel and share a postmortem early tomorrow.

Regards,
— Markus
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft)
